We are seeking a talented and driven Senior Full Stack Engineer (m/f/d) to join our team, in the Demand Division, responsible for developing our contact center applications, with the focus on scalable agent-facing interfaces and automations.
This is a unique opportunity to be part of our development team, evolving software products on a scale. As such, there will be a lot of discoveries involved in the design process, as we work to identify the most efficient and effective workflows.

Languages & Frameworks: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, flask, FastAPI, Node.js, React, Spring Boot.
Cloud Providers and IaC: AWS, Azure, terraform, serverless.
Data Layer: Elasticsearch, Snowflake
Streaming and Messaging Layer: Kafka.
Observability: Datadog, Kibana.

You will be part of a self-organized, cross-functional distributed team-owning set of products and will hence directly contribute to the success of the business.
You will maintain a core product built with Python, TypeScript, and Java/Spring
You and your team will place our users at the center when developing solutions together.
You drive the development process using an Agile environment.
You will be able to evolve products using new tech stacks.
Lead technical decisions inside and across teams to improve technical excellence through lateral leadership.

A minimum of 8+ years of professional experience in fullstack development, with a strong focus on architecture, system design, and migrating legacy products.
You have strong experience in maintaining and evolving products written in Python. Java / Spring Boot is a plus, enabling their migration to a different tech stack
You cover your code with tests and have experience with different test runners.
Your obsession with quality ensures every product meets exceptionally high standards.
You enjoy working within an agile setup.
We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.
To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.
If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

Die 3D-aero GmbH ist ein Tech-Unternehmen aus Hamburg mit etwa 70 Mitarbeitenden und ist seit Dezember 2024 ein stolzer Teil der MTU Aero Engines AG – einem der weltweit führenden Unternehmen der Luftfahrtindustrie. Wir entwickeln kundenspezifische Automatisierungslösungen für die Flugzeugproduktion und andere Industriebereiche. Dabei nutzen wir optische Sensorik und moderne Industrieroboter zusammen mit KI-basierter Datenverarbeitung, um maßgeschneiderte Systeme für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln.
Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen SPS-Programmierer (gn) für Sondermaschinen und Roboteranlagen . Wenn Dich der Themenbereich rund um Robotik und Sonderanlagenbau begeistert, dann bist Du hier richtig. Bewirb Dich und werde Teil des 3D-aero-Teams!
Aufgaben
Du entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Steuerungsprogramme für unsere Sondermaschinen und Roboteranlagen – überwiegend mit dem Siemens TIA Portal und bringst dabei eigene Ideen in die Entwicklung ein.
Du sorgst mit modernen Visualisierungssystemen, bspw. WinCC, für eine benutzerfreundliche Bedienung unserer Anlagen.
Du begleitest spannende Projekte über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg - von der Konzeptphase über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur erfolgreichen Abnahme beim Kunden im In- und Ausland.
Du arbeitest eng mit den Bereichen Konstruktion, Projektmanagement und Inbetriebnahme zusammen, um optimale Lösungen zu realisieren.
Du analysierst bestehende Steuerungsprogramme, entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter und unterstützt bei der Fehlerdiagnose sowie der nachhaltigen Störungsbehebung.
Qualifikation
Abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine sehr gute Technikerausbildung im Bereich Mechatronik, Maschinenbau, Automatisierungstechnik oder eine ähnliche technische Qualifikation
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der SPS-Programmierung, idealerweise im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau.
Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Bereich SPS-Steuerungen / Automatisierungstechnik (u.a. Siemens TIA-Portal)
Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in der Roboterprogrammierung
Kenntnisse im Bereich Schaltschrankelektrik und Sicherheitstechnik
Lösungsorientierte und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Eine attraktive und vielseitige Tätigkeit mit hoher Eigenverantwortung sowie einen zukunftssicheren Arbeitsplatz
Viele Gestaltungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem unterstützenden und respektvollen Umfeld
Firmenparkplätze und Zuschuss zu Kita-Gebühren
Kostenlose Getränke: Wasser- und Kaffeeflatrate sowie ein Angebot an diversen Soft- und Erfrischungsgetränken
Flexibles Benefit-Budget für Fahrtkostenzuschuss, Fitnessangebot, Sachbezüge und Dienstrad
30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten

NSA is seeking experienced Software Engineers to advance high-impact systems and teams. Tools and technologies used evolve quickly, with systems and responsibilities spanning the full spectrum.

Common tools and areas of interest include: COBOL, C/C++, Java, cloud computing, Angular, React, Python, PIG Analytics, Pyspark, agile development, continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD), containers and Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Linux (VMWare), ElasticSearch, Rust, micro services, Ansible, clusters, digital forensics, incident response, quantum and more.

Beyond technical skills, we need strong critical thinkers, collaborators, independent self-starters, continuous learners and flexible contributors.

We look forward to hearing from you about what excites you and where you think you can make the most impact. **Note: Please upload a copy of your transcripts from all schools attended into your Candidate Profile, prior to applying for this position. Unofficial transcripts are fine at this stage.

Minimum qualifications for this position require a degree that demonstrates a concentration of computer science (CS) courses in foundational CS areas.**
FULL PERFORMANCE Entry is with a Bachelor's degree plus 3 years of relevant experience or a Master's degree plus 1 year of relevant experience or a Doctoral degree and no experience. An Associate's degree plus 5 years of relevant experience may be considered for individuals with in-depth experience that is clearly related to the position.

SENIOR Entry is with a Bachelor's degree plus 6 years of relevant experience or a Master's degree plus 4 years of relevant experience or a Doctoral degree plus 2 years of relevant experience. An Associate's degree plus 8 years of relevant experience may be considered for individuals with in-depth experience that is clearly related to the position.

This position may be eligible for a RECRUITMENT INCENTIVE: selected candidates may be offered an incentive as part of the offer of employment. To receive the incentive, selected candidates must be eligible under 5 CFR Part 575, Subpart A, upon issuance of the Final Offer Letter.

Changes in federal employment status prior to issuance of the Final Offer Letter may affect eligibility. To receive the incentive, selected candidates will be required to sign a service agreement to stay within the position at NGA for the agreed upon time.

If the service agreement is terminated before its completion, the employee may be required to repay a pro rata share amount of the incentive to the government. Additional information regarding recruitment incentives for current federal employees can be found in DoDI 1400.25, Volume 2006.
MANDATORY QUALIFICATION CRITERIA: For this particular job, applicants must meet all competencies reflected under the Mandatory Qualification Criteria to include education (if required).

Online resumes must demonstrate qualification by providing specific examples and associated results, in response to the announcement's mandatory criteria specified in this vacancy announcement: Professional experience with database technologies such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle Database, DynamoDB, or equivalent.

Professional experience using a programming language such as Java, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent to complete software applications. Experience building web application programming interfaces (API) using standards such as REST or SOAP.

Experience with build automation tools such as Maven, Gradle, Webpack, NPM, Yarn, Jenkins, Gitlab CI, or equivalent. Experience in applying agile development methodologies to develop software. EDUCATION REQUIREMENT: A.

Education: Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Engineering, Information Science, Information Systems Management, Information Technology, Mathematics, Statistics, or a degree that provided a minimum of 24 semester hours in one or more of the fields identified above and required the development or adaptation of applications, systems, or networks. -OR- B.

Combination of Education and Experience: A minimum of 24 semester (36 quarter) hours of college coursework in any area listed in option A, plus experience in software design, information technology engineering, or a related area that demonstrates the ability to successfully perform the duties associated with this work.

As a rule, every 30 semester (45 quarter) hours of college work is equivalent to one year of experience. Candidates should show that their combination of education and experience totals 4 years. -OR- C.

Experience: A minimum of 4 years of experience in software design, information technology engineering, or a related area that demonstrates the ability to successfully perform the duties associated with this work.

DESIRABLE QUALIFICATION CRITERIA: In addition to the mandatory qualifications, experience in the following is desired: Experience with developing and deploying containerized applications to a Kubernetes container orchestration system.

Experience with frameworks such as Python Flask, Java Spring, Java Spring Boot, JavaScript React, or JavaScript Redux. Experience utilizing container technologies such as Docker, Podman, Buildah, or Containerd.

NVIDIA ’s accelerated computing platform is the foundation of modern HPC and AI.At the core of this platform are the CUDA Core Libraries. C++ and Python libraries that enable developers to write fast, reliable, and scalable GPU-accelerated software!

We are hiring a full-time Software Engineer to work on the CUDA Core Libraries that power GPU computing for both C++ and Python developers. This includes projects such asCCCL (Thrust, CUB, libcudacxx),cuda-python, andnumba-cuda.

You will join the team building the foundational libraries, algorithms, and language/runtime infrastructure that make CUDA a speed-of-light experience for developers across deep learning, scientific computing, and data analytics!

What you’ll be doing: Develop and implement CUDA Core Libraries inC++ and/or Python, including parallel algorithms and idiomatic language bindings for core CUDA functionality. Compose, optimize, and evolve GPU algorithms and APIs, from high-level interfaces down to low-level performance tuning involving memory, parallelism, and synchronization.

Own features end-to-end: develop, implementation, testing, benchmarking, documentation, and long-term maintenance. Improve developer experience across the stack: CI, tests, benchmarks, packaging, examples, and docs. Collaborate with senior CUDA engineers in design reviews, code reviews, and open-source-style workflows.

Engage with real users through issues, performance investigations, and API feedback. What we need to see: BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related fieldor equivalent experience.

Minimum of 8+ years of related development experience Strong programming skills inC++, Python, or both, with proven interest in systems-level software (performance, memory, concurrency, API design). Solid understanding of modern C++ (templates, generics, standard library) and/or Python library development and packaging.

Practical experience withparallel or heterogeneous programming(CUDA, OpenMP, GPU-accelerated Python, or similar). Experience contributing to production software or open-source libraries, including testing, profiling, and code review. Ability to work independently, scope problems, and drive projects to completion.

Clear written communication for technical design and documentation. Comfort navigating large, multi-language codebases (C++, Python, CMake, Pixi, CI systems). Ways to stand out from the crowd: Strong understanding of CPU/GPU architecture and how hardware details affect performance.

Hands-on experience withCUDA C++,CUDA Python,PyTorch,JAX,Numba,CuPy, or similar GPU-accelerated stacks. Familiarity withThrust,CUB,libcudacxx, or other modern C++/GPU libraries. Experience with compiler infrastructure or tooling (LLVM, Clang tooling, MLIR). Demonstrated interest in developer tools, library design, and making other developers faster.

If you care deeply about performance, enjoy working at the C++/Python boundary, and want to shape the core CUDA libraries relied on by thousands of developers, this role is a direct fit. Originally posted on Himalayas

Principal Software Engineer - Remote Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Principal Software Engineer Location: 100% Remote (U.S.) Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2 Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually Experience Required: 6+ years Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply.

We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position. Job Summary: We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Software Engineer to lead enterprise-wide architectural initiatives, define long-term technology strategy, and deliver highly scalable, resilient distributed systems.

This role represents the highest level of individual technical contribution within the organization, requiring deep expertise in system design, performance engineering, reliability architecture, and cross-organizational technical leadership.

The ideal candidate will drive strategic engineering decisions, serve as a technical authority across multiple teams and platforms, and combine deep technical mastery with mature judgment, broad influence, and the ability to mentor and elevate senior engineers across the organization.

Key Responsibilities Define enterprise-level architectural standards, system design principles, and engineering guardrails that shape engineering work across multiple business units. Lead the design and implementation of highly scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems that operate at global scale.

Architect multi-region, fault-tolerant, and globally distributed platforms with rigorous attention to availability, durability, and disaster recovery. Drive enterprise modernization initiatives, including microservices transformation, platform consolidation, and legacy decommissioning.

Define API governance, data architecture, and service communication patterns adopted across the engineering organization. Design systems for extreme scalability, availability, and security, including detailed capacity planning and resilience modeling.

Evaluate and select high-performance data storage solutions appropriate to each major workload class. Lead reliability engineering and incident response improvements, raising the bar on operational excellence enterprise-wide. Conduct deep architectural reviews and performance audits across multiple platforms.

Guide engineering teams on concurrency, scalability, observability, and optimization strategies. Design observability and monitoring frameworks at enterprise scale, defining standards for metrics, logs, and traces that work consistently across many teams and many production environments.

Define DevOps, CI/CD, and automation strategy across engineering teams and platforms. Partner with executive leadership and product management on technology roadmap decisions. Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers and contribute substantively to talent growth across the organization.

Drive innovation and continuously evaluate emerging technologies for strategic adoption. Lead the resolution of critical system-level production issues that require deep architectural insight. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.

Ten or more years of professional software engineering experience. Proven expertise designing distributed, high-scale systems in production. Advanced proficiency in Java, Go, C++, or similar backend languages. Deep understanding of data modeling, system optimization, and performance tuning.

Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives across multiple business units. Strong expertise in reliability engineering and distributed architectures. Demonstrated leadership in architectural decision-making at enterprise scale. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Track record of mentoring senior engineers and shaping engineering culture. Preferred Qualifications Public technical contributions (papers, talks, OSS leadership). Experience driving multi-year transformation programs. Familiarity with FinOps and large-scale cost optimization.

Exposure to regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government). Advanced degree or equivalent industry recognition. How to Apply Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to venkat.r@bvteck.com or contact us at (908) 505-3899 .

Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com . Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Their platform enables software companies to deliver immersive, hands-on experiences for sales demos, POCs, and customer training.

Trusted by top global brands, the company accelerates sales cycles, boosts engagement, and improves user adoption. With a dynamic team across Israel, the U.S., and Europe, and backed by a growth-focused investor, the company is expanding rapidly and shaping the future of virtual experiences.

Role Overview We are seeking a talented Software Development Engineer to join the team and contribute to designing, developing, and maintaining customer-facing features. In this role, you will shape the end-user experience, enable seamless collaboration, and deliver solutions that support and optimize customers’ business needs.

The ideal candidate is eager to influence product development, build, learn, and deliver high-quality software. They thrive in an agile environment, enjoy iterative development, and take pride in frequently releasing high-quality versions of the software.

Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain high-quality software applications using C# and the .NET framework Enhance and evolve public cloud-based customer experiences, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability Apply best practices and coding standards to deliver clean, maintainable, and scalable code Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve issues reported by customers and internal stakeholders Participate in code reviews to uphold engineering standards and improve overall code quality Ensure software reliability by implementing automated tests and validating end-to-end functionality Own the delivery lifecycle, taking features from development through successful production release Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field 4–6 years of hands-on software development experience Strong backend development experience using C# and .NET (mandatory) Frontend experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (Angular and TypeScript are a plus) Experience working programmatically with public cloud environments (AWS preferred) Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal Collaborative team player with a proactive, positive mindset Self-driven learner with the ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and environments Nice-to-Haves Experience with modern development and collaboration tools (JIRA, Git, Chef, TeamCity) Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and ORM frameworks Hands-on experience with public cloud platforms (AWS preferred, then Azure/GCP) Experience operating in cloud-first environments and contributing to cloud-based architecture decisions Originally posted on Himalayas

BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cyber security SaaS portfolio. Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success.

You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself. The Role BeyondTrust is seeking a Staff Software Development Engineer to help lead the evolution of the Pathfinder products within our cloud offering.

You will be at the forefront of designing and building a new platform-native module, along with scalable, secure, and extensible services that power our SaaS offerings.

As the technical owner of the NHI Governance domain, you will lead the server-side loop – discover, assess, and remediate non-human identities (service accounts, workload identities, secrets and keys, and AI agents) across cloud and on-premise environments.

As a technical leader on the team, you will own architecture for complex systems, define the interfaces and contracts that other teams build upon, and drive technical direction across cross-functional efforts, solving complex identity and security challenges at scale.

What You’ll Do Design, build, and maintain highly scalable and resilient platform services, APIs, and data pipelines. Own architecture for complex, cross-cutting systems and define the interfaces and contracts other teams depend on. Provide technical oversight and lead design for complex projects that span multiple teams.

Review functional and technical requirements to identify gaps and limitations, propose simplifications, and communicate ideas effectively with cross-functional teams. Mentor and coach engineers, promoting best practices in security, operational excellence, and cloud-native development.

Contribute to platform-wide initiatives, aligning technical strategy with business goals across BeyondTrust . Drive quality, observability, and performance across the services your team owns. Help resolve ambiguity to ensure work is properly defined, scoped, and sequenced.

What You’ll Bring Expertise in architecting and developing microservices and cloud-native solutions. Strong programming skills in C#, Go, TypeScript, Java, or other modern languages, with deep experience in API design and microservices architecture.

Hands-on experience with Claude Code (or comparable agentic AI coding tools) to design, build, and review software at high velocity, with the judgment to establish effective patterns and guardrails for the team. Experience designing systems, interfaces, and contracts consumed by multiple teams or products.

Strong, hands-on AWS expertise in designing, hosting, and operating production applications at scale, including compute (e.g., EKS), networking, IAM, managed data stores, and sound scaling, reliability, and cost trade-offs. Understanding of CICD strategies and hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).

Familiarity with data modeling, exploration, and visualization at scale. Proven track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguity while driving the technical direction. Familiarity with modern observability and test strategies in cloud environments.

Full-stack familiarity (e.g., a modern JavaScript framework such as Angular or React with TypeScript) is a plus. Nice To Have Domain experience in identity security: IAM, NHI/Secrets, cloud IAM (AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID), OAuth/OIDC. Graph databases, graph data modeling, and analytics at scale.

Experience building multi-tenant shared services consumed by other engineering teams. Who You Are A technical leader who takes ownership of complex technical challenges and delivers scalable solutions. A mentor and collaborator, eager to share knowledge and uplift the engineering team.

A bar-raiser for delivering results and relentlessly pursuing high quality. Someone who balances technical excellence with pragmatic decision-making, ensuring security without unnecessary complexity. A strong communicator, able to bridge technical and business needs in cross-team and cross-functional discussions. Better Together Diversity.

Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected. We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us.

We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together. About Us BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™.

Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners. Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com .

Junior Webentwickler (m/w/d) – Quereinsteiger willkommen!
Deine Karrierechance wartet. Werde Teil unseres Teams.
Über uns. Warum wir?
Die ATZ Group , gegründet 1973, verbindet Erfahrung mit Innovationsgeist. Unser Team aus Spezialisten entwickelt digitale Lösungen in den Bereichen Media, Marketing, Recruiting und Intelligence. Gemeinsam mit Partnern aus dem Mittelstand und internationalen Konzernen gestalten wir digitale Projekte und Erfolgsgeschichten weltweit.
Was uns besonders macht: Wir sind vielleicht das älteste Startup der Welt . Seit Jahrzehnten entwickeln wir uns weiter, probieren Neues aus und arbeiten mit modernen Technologien. Bei uns findest du keine starren Strukturen, sondern ein Umfeld, in dem Ideen, Motivation und Weiterentwicklung wirklich zählen.
Wenn du Lust hast, Dinge zu bauen, Technik wirklich zu verstehen und dich dabei in mehrere Richtungen weiterzuentwickeln, bist du bei uns richtig.
Deine Mission 🚀
Du hast Spaß daran, Websites technisch umzusetzen, und du schreckst auch nicht zurück, wenn mal etwas anderes Technisches zu tun ist. Bei uns liegt der Schwerpunkt auf der Webentwicklung, aber die Stelle ist bewusst etwas breiter angelegt. Mal baust du ein Frontend, mal hilfst du einer Kollegin bei einem technischen Problem, mal schaust du, warum eine WordPress-Seite klemmt.
Du bist also kein reiner Entwickler, der nur im Code sitzt, und auch kein klassischer IT-Supporter. Eher ein technischer Allrounder mit klarem Fokus auf Web. Wer gerne versteht, wie Dinge zusammenhängen, und nicht nur an einer einzigen Sache schraubt, fühlt sich hier wohl.
Vielleicht hast du dir vieles selbst beigebracht, erste Webprojekte umgesetzt oder einfach eine große Begeisterung für moderne Webtechnologien. Bei uns baust du dein Wissen aus und tauchst Schritt für Schritt tiefer in Webentwicklung, Softwarelogik und IT-Prozesse ein.

✔ Webentwicklung als Schwerpunkt
Du entwickelst moderne Frontends für Websites und Landingpages auf Basis bestehender Designs, setzt Projekte technisch um und entwickelst sie weiter. Responsive Layouts mit sauberem HTML und CSS gehören dazu, ebenso JavaScript für interaktive Funktionen und dynamische Inhalte.
✔ WordPress und CMS
Du arbeitest mit WordPress, pflegst Inhalte, aktualisierst Plugins und setzt Anpassungen sowie neue Seiten um. Mit der Zeit lernst du Themes, Templates und Seitenstrukturen im Detail kennen und kannst im Code nachschauen, wenn etwas nicht läuft.
✔ APIs und Funktionalität
Du bindest APIs und externe Services ein, entwickelst Formulare, dynamische Elemente und funktionale Komponenten und hilfst dabei, die Performance und eine saubere Codebasis im Blick zu behalten.
✔ Technische Unterstützung im Team
Wenn Kolleginnen und Kollegen ein technisches Problem haben, bist du ansprechbar. Das reicht von Fragen rund um Tools und Zugänge bis hin zu kleineren Hürden im Arbeitsalltag. Du musst nicht alles sofort können, aber du gehst die Dinge an und findest Lösungen.
✔ IT- und Systemthemen
Du bekommst Einblick in allgemeine IT-Themen wie Webhosting, Domains und technische Systemstrukturen und hilfst mit, verschiedene Tools und Plattformen sinnvoll zu verbinden. So wächst du nach und nach über die reine Entwicklung hinaus.
✔ Fehleranalyse und Optimierung
Wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, gehst du strukturiert vor: Problem eingrenzen, Lösungen recherchieren, Fehler beheben. Ob in einer Website, einem Tool oder einem Setup.
✔ Moderne Technologien
Du hast die Möglichkeit, mit Technologien wie React, Next.js oder Tailwind CSS zu arbeiten und dich dort weiterzuentwickeln.
✔ Zusammenarbeit
Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams aus Marketing, IT, Design und Content zusammen.
Dein Profil. Was du mitbringst 💡

s.h: Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du
s.t:
✔ erste praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Websites gesammelt hast, ob über eigene Projekte, Tutorials, Bootcamps oder autodidaktisch
✔ gute Grundkenntnisse in HTML und CSS mitbringst
✔ bereits mit JavaScript gearbeitet hast und dein Wissen vertiefen möchtest
✔ Interesse an WordPress hast oder idealerweise schon erste Erfahrungen
✔ ein echtes technisches Verständnis hast und keine Scheu, dich auch in Themen außerhalb der reinen Entwicklung einzuarbeiten
✔ kein Problem damit hast, mal anderen Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei technischen Fragen zu helfen
✔ neugierig bist und verstehen möchtest, wie moderne Websites und Systeme technisch aufgebaut sind
✔ strukturiert arbeitest, gerne dazulernst und Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung übernehmen willst
Wenn du Leidenschaft für Webentwicklung mitbringst und gleichzeitig Lust hast, technischer Allrounder zu werden, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

✔ 30 Tage Urlaub für deine Erholung
✔ Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag für Planungssicherheit
✔ Attraktive Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bis hin zur Teamleitung
✔ Persönlicher Mentor als Unterstützung beim Einstieg

Welcome to Motorola Solutions . By applying for this role, you will become a founding technical member of the new CC Insights team. Our hybrid team—spanning the US and South Africa—is building a unified reporting application that combines various reporting products acquired and built in-house over the past few years.

We aim to deliver a seamless analytics experience featuring embedded PowerBI reports and an innovative AI-assisted workflow that empowers users to chat with their data. This product sits on a robust data foundation powered by our internal Data Platform (BDP), leveraging Databricks and Azure Data Lake for our Bronze and Silver data layers.

The new Insights team owns the Gold layer (Synapse via Databricks) and the unified web application. You will be joining a highly collaborative group of Data and Software Engineers, while working closely with the Data Platform Engineering (DPE) team.

You will drive the development of our C# backend and Angular frontend, integrate PowerBI via the Embedded SDK, and architect scalable, multi-tenant microservices. You will also play a key role in migrating functionalities from various other reporting products into our unified frontend.

A commitment to collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, and a thirst for elegant code is a must. Key Responsibilities
Build the Foundation: Develop and maintain the unified CC Insights web app, integrating embedded PowerBI reports via the Angular SDK and facilitating AI-assisted workflows.
Architectural Stewardship: Work within a layered architecture spanning controllers, services, repositories, and data-access components, while improving boundaries where they are weak or overly coupled.
Legacy Migration: Evaluate and migrate features from various reporting products into Insights, requiring code analysis of existing systems.
Data & Multi-Tenancy: Develop and optimize multi-tenant data access patterns using EF Core, SQL Server, and tenant-aware access controls.

Frontend Engineering: Contribute to frontend state management patterns using Angular and centralized state tools such as NgRx.
Technical Leadership: Lead technical design and code reviews, identify architectural risks early, and drive pragmatic improvements rather than cosmetic rewrites.
Operational Excellence: Debug production issues across application, infrastructure, and data layers using logs, traces, and metrics. Partner with product, QA, DevOps, and other engineers to deliver features with clear operational ownership.
DevOps & Pipeline Automation: Design, build, and manage robust CI/CD pipelines utilizing GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps (ADO) to ensure seamless continuous integration, automated testing, and reliable deployment of our C# backend and Angular frontend services.
Mentorship: Mentor other engineers through design guidance, code review, and engineering standards.

Core Backend Skills: Proficient in C#, with a good knowledge of its ecosystems. Familiarity with the .NET framework as well as .Net Core, alongside a strong understanding of object-oriented programming.

What you can expect from us We are building a new team that takes end-to-end ownership of AI initiatives – from strategy through to production. In many AI projects, there is a gap between the strategy and what ultimately makes it into production and creates real business value. That is exactly the gap we close.
Our work does not stop at the concept stage, nor does it begin with a finished specification. An initiative stays in the same hands from the first idea to a production system that delivers measurable impact. We are driven by outcomes, not by the traditional consulting model. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies.
You will join the founding team and help shape what we build, not just how we build it. We work with the latest models and tools and choose the technologies we need to deliver the best results for our clients. There is no prescribed tech stack – we use the right tool for each challenge.
This role goes well beyond traditional AI engineering. You will shape technical solutions from the initial idea through to production and work closely with senior decision-makers on both the client and management side.

s.h: What you’ll do as part of our new FDE team
s.t:
You own the architecture and technical delivery of the AI solution end to end – from strategy through to production.
You build agentic systems, RAG pipelines, and LLM integrations in real-world enterprise environments.
Agentic coding tools are part of your daily workflow: you use them to build solutions, accelerate code reviews, and create deployment pipelines.
You are involved from the very first idea, not just once the specification is finalized – giving you the opportunity to grow deeper into the strategic and commercial side of the business.
You stay accountable through to the outcome: you do not hand off responsibility but drive the solution all the way through until it is live and delivering measurable impact.
You own and defend your technical decisions directly at the executive level, leading these conversations yourself rather than through an intermediary.
Who you are You take ownership of the entire outcome, not just one part of it. You stay accountable until the solution is live in production and delivering measurable impact. You bring a founder and product mindset rather than simply executing assigned tasks.
You build hands-on, at the highest level – and think beyond the code. From an engineering perspective, you have already deployed LLM-based systems to production and understand the business rationale behind them, not just the architecture.
You can hold your own at the executive level. You have personally owned and defended technical decisions in front of senior executives. You bring that experience with you – this is not something we will first need to develop.
A proven track record of taking LLM-based systems into production – ideally in a Forward-Deployed Engineer or Founding Engineer role.
Excellent, production-grade Python skills, including technologies and practices such as FastAPI, containers, Git, and CI/CD, combined with a deep understanding of agentic architectures, retrieval methods, and function calling.
You use agentic coding tools as a core part of your engineering workflow, not as a gimmick – including when building deployment pipelines.
You are eager to go beyond the boundaries of traditional engineering roles and develop deeper expertise on the strategic side of the business.

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.
Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.
Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.
Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware
Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

Impact: Your simulations will directly shape the magnets that enable commercial fusion energy.
Ownership: As part of a small, highly technical team, you will define modeling standards and influence core design decisions.
Frontier Engineering: Work at the intersection of high-field electromagnetics, cryogenics, and advanced numerical methods.
Collaboration: Join a team combining deep superconducting expertise with advanced computational capability to solve one of the hardest engineering challenges of our time.

At Proxima Fusion, we are designing the first generation of fusion power plants to provide the world with clean, carbon-free energy. The heart of our reactor lies in its superconducting coils. These magnets operate at cryogenic temperatures, generate extreme magnetic fields, and must remain stable under complex electromagnetic and thermal transients.
We are looking for a Numerical Modeling Engineer to develop high-fidelity simulation tools that predict and de-risk the behavior of our superconducting magnets. Your work will span electromagnetic, thermal, and transient multiphysics modeling - including quench dynamics - and will directly inform design decisions for conductors, coils, and protection systems.
This role is not about running black-box simulations. It is about building robust numerical frameworks - combining commercial multiphysics tools with in-house developed models - to enable fast, reliable, physics-driven engineering decisions.

Your work will combine physics modeling, numerical implementation, and close collaboration with magnet designers and experimental teams. You will contribute across three primary domains:
1. Electromagnetic & Thermal Multiphysics Modeling
You will develop predictive models of superconducting magnet behavior across steady-state and transient regimes.
Electromagnetic Simulation: Model high-field magnet systems including current distribution, inductance, AC losses, and nonlinear material behavior.
Thermal Modeling: Simulate heat generation, conduction, and cryogenic cooling performance under operational and fault conditions.
Multiphysics Coupling: Develop coupled EM-thermal models to capture transient events such as current redistribution and localized heating.
Quench Modeling: Implement and validate numerical frameworks to simulate quench initiation, propagation, and protection strategies.
Model Validation: Correlate simulations with experimental data from conductor and coil tests to continuously refine predictive capability.
2. In-House Tool Development & Numerical Infrastructure
Beyond commercial software, you will help build Proxima’s internal modeling backbone.
Custom Solvers & Reduced-Order Models: Develop fast, scalable modeling tools for system-level studies and design iteration.
Automation & Parametric Studies: Build robust pipelines for design sweeps, optimization, and uncertainty quantification.
Code Development: Contribute to internal Python- or C++-based frameworks for magnet modeling and data post-processing.
Verification & Benchmarking: Establish numerical best practices, validation procedures, and cross-comparison between tools.
Scalability: Ensure models can scale from conductor-level physics to full magnet assemblies.
Experience with COMSOL or similar commercial multiphysics tools (ANSYS, Opera, etc.) is valuable, but building reliable, physics-based in-house tools is equally (if not more) important.
3. Design Integration & Engineering Decision Support
Your models will not live in isolation — they will directly shape hardware.
Design Feedback: Provide quantitative guidance on conductor layout, stabilization strategies, and protection schemes.
Risk Assessment: Identify failure modes and quantify margins under realistic operating scenarios.
Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with magnet engineers, quench protection specialists, and test engineers.
Documentation & Communication: Translate complex physics into clear engineering recommendations.
We are looking for a rigorous numerical thinker who enjoys bridging fundamental physics and practical engineering.

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN ’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.
With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way: responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.
Platform Engineering builds what the rest of IREN builds on. We own data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, and product engineering, the systems that turn a fleet of data centers and GPU clusters into a platform our customers and our own teams can move quickly on. Much of it is being built now, for the first time, so there is no legacy stack to maintain and no established playbook to follow.
We are hiring senior software engineers across Platform Engineering. This is an individual contributor role. Seniority here is measured by the scope of what you own and by how much better the engineers around you get, not by how many people report to you. At this level you own the design of whole systems, including the parts that cross team boundaries and the parts you will not build yourself.
The part of the role we weight most heavily is what you do for the engineers around you. We expect you to raise the standard of the people you work with, through design review and code review that teach rather than correct, through pairing, and through handing hard problems to engineers who are ready to stretch. We look for evidence of this during the interview, and we continue to assess it after you join.
Because Platform Engineering builds for other teams, the boundaries matter as much as the internals. You will own the interfaces between your systems and everyone else's, negotiate what those contracts guarantee, and manage versioning and compatibility when something has to change.

That work is as much communication as design, so we expect you to write clearly and to be comfortable in a room where people disagree. We also expect depth: senior engineers here are the person the company asks about a particular domain, whether that is data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, or product engineering.

Engineers at every level at IREN stay hands on, senior ones included. Responsibilities
Own system design from end to end: the problem statement, architecture, interfaces, data model, and rollout, including the parts other engineers will build.
Coach and develop the engineers around you. Give review that teaches, pair on hard problems, and hand over work that stretches people rather than keeping it because you would finish it faster.
Own the API contracts between your systems and other teams: negotiate what they guarantee, version them, and manage the migration when they change.
Set technical direction for your area, and write it down so other teams can build against it without needing a meeting first.
Break large, ambiguous problems into work that a team can sequence, estimate, and deliver.
Lead delivery across team boundaries, including the coordination and follow up that this actually requires.
Stay hands on. Write and review code, and carry the pager for what you own.
Own operations for your systems: monitoring, on-call, incident response, and the follow up that stops the same incident recurring.
Be the person the company can ask about your domain, and make what you know available to others rather than holding it.
Raise the standard through the systems around the code: CI/CD, observability, testing practice, and documentation.

This role involves building robust, scalable microservices and integrations crucial for fleet operations, process integrations, and data processing in a cloud-native environment. You will play a key part in translating complex business requirements into reliable and efficient backend solutions.
What you’ll be doing
Design and implement backend services for integrating RIVR's platform with our customers’ systems, to provide delightful delivery experiences.
Develop and enhance the backend infrastructure for our robot operations platform.
Develop backend components to aggregate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), providing insights into platform performance and business value.
Contribute to the overall architecture , reliability, and scalability of our backend systems within a containerized microservices context.
Collaborate closely with frontend, robotics, and infrastructure engineers to deliver end-to-end features

Approximately 5 years of professional experience designing, building, deploying, and operating backend systems in a Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) context. You have production experience with:
Strong experience with Typescript, Java, C++ and/or Python
Service decomposition.
API design.
Different interaction patterns (e.g. RPC, publish/subscribe, event-driven).
At least two database technologies
Trading off consistency for availability/performance.
Proven experience (5+ major services) with at least one major cloud provider (AWS strongly preferred).

s.h: Demonstrable experience in at least one of the following areas
s.t:
Integrating with complex third-party APIs and building reliable, distributed workflows (e.g., using task queues, state machines).
Building event-driven applications and/or scalable data processing pipelines (e.g., using Kafka, message queues, serverless functions).
A business-oriented mindset , with a focus on leveraging technology to solve concrete problems and deliver value.
A strong sense of ownership , comfortable venturing beyond immediate expertise to understand and solve problems effectively.
The ability to earn trust by providing and receiving candid, constructive feedback.
Willingness to participate in on-call rotations to ensure the reliability of our production systems.
Excellent communication skills , with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas clearly and drive mutual understanding across teams with diverse technical backgrounds.

Familiarity configuring and operating CI/CD pipelines .
Background in robotics, IoT, fleet management, or real-time data streaming systems.
Strong familiarity with observability such as OTLP, Grafana, prometheus , etc preferably in the context of devices with intermittent connectivity
RIVR, part of Amazon is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team.
We believe the best work is done when collaborating and therefore require in-person presence in our office locations.
